# Ordinals Wallet passthrough v4 vectors

Copied unchanged from https://github.com/ordinals-wallet/ow-cli (MIT, see LICENSE here), commit
f991b1f, `fixtures/purchase-verify.json` and `fixtures/escrow.json`. They are generated by Ordinals Wallet's own
SDK (`packages/core/__tests__/shared-vectors/generate.ts`) from throwaway keys that have never held funds: honest
protected-listing sales and the same sales tampered in one named way each, with the verifier's expected outcome.

The canister's protected-listing judge (`owbuy.rs`) is held to these: every case Ordinals Wallet's verifier accepts
or refuses, the canister's must decide the same way where its rules are the same, and the cases where the canister
is stricter are listed in its tests by name.
